issuing_body: European AI Office / Signatory Taskforce of the General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
covered_actors: Signatories to the GPAI Code of Practice
implementation_notes: This Vademecum governs the internal organisation and operation of the Signatory Taskforce under the GPAI Code of Practice, which was assessed as adequate pursuant to Article 56(6) of the AI Act. It is not itself a binding instrument but structures voluntary cooperation among signatories. The AI Office chairs the Taskforce and may publish the Vademecum, participant lists, and high-level meeting minutes under its transparency obligations. Decisions are taken by consensus with a default agreement period of no less than 10 working days.
